basis_label: Dimensions and anatomical or structural basis
author: Universe Scales
note: Original exterior illustration of Prelude FLNG, using Shell’s 488 m overall length and 74 m width and the International Gas Union 2015–2018 FLNG report’s 42 m hull depth. The full hull is shown. Stern accommodation, the central pipe corridor, process modules and forward turret follow the broad arrangement visible in Shell’s construction films; fourteen module frames refer to Shell’s stated fourteen topside modules. Hull sections, module dimensions/equipment, crane and flare geometry, colors and all smaller details are authored schematic approximations, not a shipyard or process-engineering model. Subsea turret extent, mooring chains, risers, internal tanks and operational waterline are omitted.

processing.details: All other shapes, placements, surface pattern and colors are authored illustration controls, not measured data.
